tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: List product releases, newest first. Filter by brand, product line, or date. Each release includes recorded case_sizes_mm, size_variants with size-attributable specifications, and buy_links. Unknown sizes are explicitly marked.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Find products by (partial) name, e.g. 'fenix 9', 'forerunner 970'. Returns the release record, generation chain, case_sizes_mm, size_variants with specifications and caveats per model and case size, and buy_links. Missing size data is unknown. tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: Predicted next-release windows per flagship family, computed from average historical release cadence. Includes overdue flags.

tools.name: get_rumors
tools.description: Current rumors, leaks and confirmed items with confidence status and sources.

tools.name: compare_generations
tools.description: Spec diff between two products from a comparison table. Returns case_sizes_mm and size_variants per product.
